tasks.callout: If you don't hand your provisional licence to the examiner, or your name or address has changed, you must apply for your full licence using form D1 within 2 years of passing — otherwise the pass lapses and you must retake the test.
tasks.what_to_expect: You book a slot at a local DVSA test centre, choosing between a weekday test or a more expensive evening/weekend slot.
